title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) to debut Sunday
items.desc: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) will play Sunday against the Packers.
items.impact: A second-round pick pick in this year's NFL Draft, Ponds was forced to put off his debut for a week due to a calf injury. The former Indiana Hoosier will be ready to take the field for the Jets in Week 2.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Will McDonald IV (ankle) good to go for Week 2
items.desc: Will McDonald IV (ankle) is expected to be ready for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: McDonald popped up on Thursday's injury report with an ankle issue, but the fourth-year pass rusher will be ready to go Sunday, according to head coach Aaron Glenn. McDonald picked up his first sack of the season in Week 1.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lions D/ST dismal in loss Thursday
items.desc: The Lions' D/ST logged two sacks and allowed 41 points in Thursday night's loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Detroit's defense looked terrible on Thursday night. They allowed Buffalo's offense to move the ball at will and gave up 41 points over the course of the night, which led to a loss for the team. They also looked poor against the Saints in Week 1, so this is shaping up to be a bad unit for the Lions, although we may get to see a better side to them with an easy schedule coming up over the next few weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Bates perfect in loss Thursday
items.desc: Jake Bates went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Bates did his job on Thursday night. He made all five of his kicks over the course of the game, so he carries no blame for Detroit's loss to the Bills. He should continue to be a quality fantasy asset at the position moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam LaPorta hauls in touchdown Thursday
items.desc: Sam LaPorta hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 52 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: LaPorta had a good showing on Thursday night. He caught all but one of his targets and turned that into 52 yards and a touchdown in a shootout loss against the Buffalo Bills. He might struggle with consistency moving forward but will continue to have as high of a TD upside as anyone for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa catches two passes Thursday
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa caught 2-of-5 targets for 26 yards in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: TeSlaa saw more involvement on Thursday night than he did in the team's season opener last week. He was targeted five times, but he was only able to turn that into two catches for 26 yards. He won't be fantasy relevant moving forward unless someone ahead of him on the depth chart goes down with an injury.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jameson Williams underwhelming in loss Thursday
items.desc: Jameson Williams caught 2-of-4 targets for 33 yards in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Williams had another disappointing performance on Thursday night. He caught just two passes in this matchup against the Bills and was only able to turn that into 33 scoreless yards, leaving him with a poor fantasy total on the night. Fantasy managers should recognize his low week-to-week floor when determining whether or not to start him in any given game moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown scores twice in loss Thursday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 6-of-8 targets for 142 yards and two touchdowns in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: St. Brown was on fire on Thursday night. He had a slow start, but he ended up finishing the game with a team high in receptions and receiving yards while finding the end zone twice against the Bills. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, especially in PPR scoring formats.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sione Vaki uninvolved in loss Thursday
items.desc: Sione Vaki rushed the ball one time for seven yards and caught one pass for 13 yards in Thursday's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Vaki continues to make minimal impact on Detroit's offense. He has squarely established himself as the RB2 behind Jahmyr Gibbs, but that role hasn't furnished him with many opportunities over the first two weeks of the season. He remains nothing more than a mid-tier handcuff option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs plays well in loss Thursday
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed the ball 16 times for 52 yards and caught 6-of-8 targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Thursday's game wasn't great for Gibbs in terms of efficiency, but he was still able to accumulate over 100 yards and a touchdown on Thursday night, which left him with a great fantasy total in this shootout matchup against the Bills. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option at the RB position for the remainder of the season, provided he remains healthy for most of it.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jimmy Horn Jr. signs with Browns practice squad
items.desc: Jimmy Horn Jr. officially signed with the Browns' practice squad on Friday.
items.impact: Horn opened the season with the Panthers, returning punts and kicks while also getting one target in the passing game during Week 1. The second-year pro out of Colorado fumbled a punt in the season-opening loss, which led to a Bears' field-goal. Horn was let go by the Panthers earlier this week and has joined his former college teammate Shedeur Sanders in Cleveland.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Goff throws four touchdowns in win Thursday
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 26-of-38 passing attempts for 327 yards and four touchdowns in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Goff and Detroit's offense struggled at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they were able to get things going later, and he ended up throwing four touchdowns in a shootout loss to the Buffalo Bills. He has looked terrific to start the season and should continue to be a safe week-to-week streaming option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bills D/ST allows 31 points in win Thursday
items.desc: The Bills' D/ST logged four sacks and allowed 31 points in Thursday night's win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Buffalo's defense looked good at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they weren't able to sustain that energy throughout and ended up allowing 31 points over the course of the night. This unit has some talent but will have a tough schedule coming up for the next three weeks at least, so fantasy managers shouldn't put much trust in them at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Bass scores five points Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Bass went 5-for-6 on his extra-point attempts in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Bass ended Thursday night's game with a total of five points, but he missed one of his extra point attempts in this game, which was less than ideal. He should remain a solid fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dawson Knox finds end zone Thursday
items.desc: Dawson Knox caught two passes for five yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The veteran tight end wasn't very involved as a pass catcher on Thursday night, but he was still able to leave his mark by catching a touchdown against the Lions. Dalton Kincaid is the clear top receiving TE for this team right now, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect Knox to be relevant at any point this season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joshua Palmer hauls in long touchdown Thursday
items.desc: Joshua Palmer hauled in 1-of-3 targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't very involved on Thursday night, but he was able to catch one of his three targets and take it 43 yards to the house for a touchdown. Still, fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, even if DJ Moore (shoulder) misses time for Buffalo.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keon Coleman totals 63 yards in win Thursday
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught six passes for 63 yards in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Coleman was able to capitalize on Buffalo's momentum on Thursday night. He finished the game with 63 yards in a win over the Lions, which is the highest total that he has accumulated since Week 1 of last season. He may see more work than usual for a few weeks if DJ Moore (shoulder) has to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ray Davis silent in win Thursday
items.desc: Ray Davis did not see a single target or carry in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Davis was a complete non-factor on Thursday night. He saw no opportunities against the Lions and played just ten snaps overall. James Cook III remains the clear bellcow back for Buffalo right now, and that's unlikely to change at any point this season barring injury.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Khalil Shakir totals 38 yards in win Thursday
items.desc: Khalil Shakir caught 3-of-6 targets for 38 yards in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't very impactful on Thursday night, catching just three passes for 38 yards on a night where Buffalo's offense couldn't be stopped. He isn't expected to be a strong fantasy option for the foreseeable future, although he may be primed for more work than usual for a week or two if DJ Moore (shoulder) has to miss time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Kincaid electric in win Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid caught 7-of-8 passing attempts for 95 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Kincaid's great start to the season continued on Thursday night. He was Buffalo's leading receiver against the Lions and was able to get into the end zone on one of his seven catches, which left him with a great fantasy total. It looks like he may be in the midst of a big breakout season right now, so long as he and QB Josh Allen stay healthy for the majority of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: James Cook III plays well in win Thursday
items.desc: James Cook III rushed the ball 21 times for 135 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Buffalo's offense was firing on all cylinders on Thursday night, and that included Cook. He rushed for 135 yards at an efficient clip of 6.5 yards per carry on the night and was able to get into the end zone on one of those carries. He wasn't very involved in the passing game, but he still dominated the backfield and was the only running back to receive even a single opportunity for the Bills.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Avonte Maddox (foot) exits Thursday's game early
items.desc: Avonte Maddox sustained a foot injury in Tuesday's game and exited early.
items.impact: Maddox went down with a foot injury in the second quarter of Thursday's loss to the Bills and ultimately did not return. He was reportedly walking with a boot and crutches after the game. His status should be further updated by the Lions on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Allen scores five touchdowns in dominant showing Thursday
items.desc: Josh Allen completed 20-of-31 passing attempts for 248 yards and three touchdowns while adding 69 yards and two touchdowns on the ground in Sunday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Allen had an insane showing on Thursday night. He totaled over 300 yards and scored five total touchdowns en route to a big win over the Lions in primetime, all while protecting the ball and committing zero turnovers. He has been absolutely dominant through the first two games of the season and is pacing to be one of, if not the most valuable individual player that anyone can roster at this point.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) diagnosed with AC joint sprain, status day-to-day
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) has been diagnosed with an AC joint sprain and his status is day-to-day. A source said "He has a chance to play next week, but it's not a lock."
items.impact: Moore was injured while trying to catch a pass in the endzone, falling hard on his shoulder as a defensive back rolled over top of him. At first the injury looked serious, but he was able to sit up and walk off the field under his own power. More than likely Moore will miss at least a week, but if there's any silver lining, the Bills get a mini-bye here thanks to the Thursday night game. Once he returns he will go back to being a featured target in the Bills passing attack. But if he misses time, Dalton Kincaid and Khalil Shakir will be the primary targets for Josh Allen, but don't sleep on Keon Coleman, who saw some sneaky good usage once, and even before, Moore was knocked out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Okada (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Ty Okada did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okada remains on track to miss a second straight game to start the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp (back) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kupp was upgraded after he was limited on Wednesday. He'll remain in the WR4/WR5 range for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jones (knee) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Josh Jones remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jones remains on track to be good to go in his depth role on the offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jobe (wrist) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Josh Jobe logged a full practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jobe remains on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton (hamstring) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Tory Horton remained a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Horton has logged back-to-back full practices. He remains on track to make his season debut on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle/hip) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Emmanwori has been limited in practice since last week. His status remains up in the air heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Bradford was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bradford remains on track to be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) active for Thursday night
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) is active for the Lions game against the Bills on Thursday.
items.impact: Reed was initially questionable to play with a foot injury, but was not among the inactives list. The veteran will try to bolster a struggling secondary against a passing attack that took down Houston on Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: T.J. Sanders (illness) inactive for Thursday
items.desc: T.J. Sanders (illness) is inactive for the Bills game against the Lions on Thursday.
items.impact: Sanders went down with an illness earlier this week and won't make it back in time for the Bills home opener. Landon Jackson is next in line for snaps, so expect an increased role on his part.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Skyler Bell (healthy scratch) inactive against Lions
items.desc: Skyler Bell (healthy scratch) is inactive against the Lions on Thursday.
items.impact: Bell missed the Bills opening contest, and will now miss their home opener. He's going to have to work hard to crack the receiver rotation in Buffalo.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) inactive for Thursday against Lions
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) is inactive for the Bills game against the Lions on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnson missed the Bills Week 1 contest against Houston, and is inactive yet again. He will rest up and hope to be available for Week 3. In his absence, Ray Davis will handle primary RB2 duties.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) officially misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Bowers missed another practice on Thursday, which makes it highly likely that he will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Chargers. Assuming he is ruled out for that matchup, fantasy managers should look for Michael Mayer to see more opportunities in Week 2 as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday.
items.impact: DeJean returned to practice in a limited fashion for the Eagles on Wednesday, which gives him a real chance to suit up and play in Week 2. We should have a better idea of whether or not he will play this week sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pec) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Greenard continues to trend the right way for Week 2, as he has been able to take part in both of Philadelphia's practices so far this week. It looks like he will be available to make his season debut against the Titans this week, which should bolster the Eagles' pass rush.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Carter (wrist) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Carter (wrist) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Philadelphia's star defensive tackle was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being sidelined by a wrist injury on Wednesday. It looks like he will play this week, which is a good development for the Eagles' defense ahead of a juicy matchup against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (rib) doesn't practice again Thursday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (rib) did not take part in Los Angeles' practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: McConkey seems to be trending towards missing Sunday's game against the Raiders, as he has yet to practice this week after suffering a rib injury in the season opener last week. That's unfortunate after his strong start in Week 1, and if he's ruled out prior to game time on Sunday, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris both stand to benefit from his absence from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ed Oliver suffers hip injury in pregame warmups Thursday
items.desc: Ed Oliver suffered a hip injury in pregame warmups for the Buffalo Bills and has been ruled out Thursday night according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Oliver's injury will be further evaluated, as the star defensive tackle's absence will leave the Buffalo defense with out a key interior presence against the Lions Thursday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (rest/Achilles) back to full practice Thursday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw (rest/Achilles) was back and practicing in full for the 49ers on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to return to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being sidelined for injury management purposes on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 2 and will continue to play a big role for San Francisco's defense in a favorable matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kaelon Black (groin) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Kaelon Black (groin) was added to the injury report as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has been picked up in many leagues as a high-end handcuff after looking good in Week 1, but he is now dealing with a groin injury and was limited on Thursday as a result. He could miss Sunday's game because of it, but we should get more clarity on the nature and degree of this injury sometime in the next day or two.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) returned to practice for the 49ers as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, McCaffrey returns to being a full participant at practice on Thursday after being given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day. He should be good to go for Week 2 and is primed for a huge workload against the Dolphins, especially now that Kaelon Black (groin) has been added to the injury report for the 49ers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) limited again Thursday
items.desc: George Kittle (Achilles) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Kittle was limited for another practice on Thursday, which should come as no surprise given that the team is trying to be cautious while he ramps his workload back up after suffering a devastating Achilles injury at the end of last season. He should return to a full workload sometime within the next few weeks if his recovery continues to progress well, at which point he will likely return to being a great fantasy asset for the remainder of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: San Francisco's star fullback was again limited on Thursday due to the finger injury that continues to bother him. He should play on Sunday without any limitations however, which is good news for Christian McCaffrey and San Francisco's running game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (rest/knee) back at practice as limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (rest/knee) was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Bosa was able to practice on Thursday, but the team continued to limit his workload and he didn't practice in full. He should play without any restrictions in Week 2, however, barring any setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eddy Pineiro (illness) absent from another practice Thursday
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro (illness) was absent from another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Pineiro is still recovering from an illness and was not at San Francisco's practice on Thursday as a result. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against Miami, however, as this illness is likely nothing more than a day-to-day issue.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Chop Robinson (concussion) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Miami's edge rusher recently entered the NFL's concussion protocols and was not able to practice on Thursday as a result. It looks like he is going to be sidelined this week, which is a tough break for the Dolphins ahead of a very tough matchup against the 49ers.
